outcome: Give CPG teams a working Secondary-Sales & Route-to-Market Analytics capability on their own data — it reveals real demand and distribution gaps.
overview: In the distributor-led channels that dominate CPG across the Gulf, a brand’s visibility usually stops at the warehouse door. Primary invoices rarely reconcile to what distributors actually sold, so real demand, coverage gaps and channel overstock all stay hidden until returns arrive. Secondary-Sales & Route-to-Market Analytics harmonises distributor secondary sales, primary shipments and the outlet master into one reconciled view, scores outlet performance and recommends how the sales beat should change. Sales leadership owns the route plan; the analytics supply the argument for changing it. Redington delivers this in five weeks on the customer’s own distributor feeds, with coverage and primary-to-secondary gap baselines measured before the build begins.
